comparator.name: Bachelor Civil Engineering
comparator.sourceNotes: Fresh 2026–2027 OER/Annex Arts2–4 confirm 60+60+60EC. Retain ordinary broad degree, no tracks; first-listed Q3 Climate Impacts and Engineering and Q4 Design of Water Treatment selected independently of UCR fit. Minor30 remains approved open space without overlap; 60+60+minor30+three4EC mandatory units+two4EC choices+individual10EC final project=180 uniqueEC. Bouwplaats aggregate8EC is counted once in each year. Water en Techniek CTB1215-26 and Transport en Planning CTB1420-25 govern over older chart labels. The 10EC individual integrating project includes ethics reflection; the ethics portfolio and Bouwplaats practical obligations add no credits. Specific course entry rules defer to the study guide and must not be invented from general progression. No accepted UCR schedule depends on unresolved external admission conditions.

programmes.label: Bachelor Civil Engineering at Delft University of Technology

exception.reason: Civil Engineering integrates structural and soil mechanics, hydraulic behaviour, construction materials, foundations and transport with repeated technical design and practical work. UCR provides meaningful water, environmental, mathematical and design-method study, but the tested combination does not form a sustained curriculum in analysing and designing civil infrastructure.
exception.curriculumContext: The complete Delft curriculum totals 180 EC, including a 30-EC minor, two restricted 4-EC choices and a 10-EC individual final project.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: A full feasible candidate was tested with Building with Nature, Living with Water, soil/aquifer investigation, environmental treatment, Spatial Planning, Linear Systems and Consumer Product Design. Its environmental investigations and general design methods do not establish a civil-infrastructure engineering programme.

candidateAssessment.concept: Water systems, environmental science and engineering methods
candidateAssessment.assessment: Relevant delta interventions, geospatial evidence, treatment chemistry and mathematical systems were tested together. Their main activities do not develop sustained hydraulic, structural and geotechnical infrastructure design.

candidateAssessment.concept: Water resilience, public infrastructure and communities
candidateAssessment.assessment: Economics, sociology and governance add substantive stakeholder and public-decision perspectives. They do not repair the missing technical infrastructure-design formation.
Material properties, soil fieldwork, modelling and spatial tools provide partial foundations. They do not form a structure/foundation or road/rail engineering sequence.

audience.programmeDescription: Delft’s Civil Engineering bachelor studies structures, water and transport through mathematics, mechanics, materials, design and practical projects. Students complete a minor, specialist electives and an individual final project.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers related study in water management, nature-based interventions, environmental science, spatial analysis, mathematics and design methods. These strengths do not combine into a sustained programme in civil-infrastructure analysis and design, so a full UCR comparison is not offered.

curriculum.limitation: The 30-EC minor remains open, subject to approval and overlap rules. The two specialist electives follow the required deep-dive and design categories. The final project is individual and includes an ethics reflection.
